thread:
miguel: Heads-up — noticed a spike in provisional charges for a handful of streaming sessions after yesterday's Canary fallback. Seems like the session tag gets dropped when router hands off to fallback route, so we double-count the prefix tokens.
anya: Can you paste a compact log excerpt? Curious whether it's a tag propagation bug or a ledger race.
miguel: sure, snippet from the router handoff log:
```
2026-02-18T22:14:32Z router=route-a session_id=ephemeral-xyz routing=handoff -> route-b reason=capacity_fallback session_tag=null
2026-02-18T22:14:33Z route-b attach session_id=ephemeral-xyz session_tag=null prefix_capture=sha1:abc123
2026-02-18T22:14:34Z stream.start session_id=ephemeral-xyz tokens=+120 provisional=true
```
anya: ok. client originally set a session_tag, right? where does it disappear?
miguel: client did set X-Session-Tag: user-tenant-42; it shows up on the initial request in router logs but the handoff event doesn't carry it. I suspect the internal handoff RPC doesn't forward header metadata unless explicitly whitelisted.
jess: rough impact estimate? how often do we see this?
miguel: ~60 events over 12h during canary. Each duplicated ~50-150 tokens. Not huge, but noisy for billing/alerts.
luke: two levers: (A) change router->worker RPC to forward session_tag and treat it as sticky for retries/fallbacks, or (B) add a dedupe key on the ledger side: prefer client_session_tag if present, else fall back to session_id. Option A seems cleaner but risks touching hot path.
anya: Also UX side: console currently shows per-route token spend and provisional credits but doesn't show "attribution source" granularity (client tag vs ephemeral). We should add a column/tag so CS can see which were client-tagged.
jess: +1 on console column. I'll mock a small UX: new filter "Attribution: client_tag / ephemeral / unknown" and a toast explaining provisional vs confirmed.
luke: telemetry: we should emit a distinct event when handoff drops a session_tag so we can alert on it. Proposal: add router.telemetry event: {"event":"handoff.missing_session_tag","route_from":"...","route_to":"...","session_id":"...","client_tag_present":true}. That'll let us build an SLO alert.
miguel: and ledger change: when we ingest provisional tokens, attach two fields: attribution_key and attribution_source. attribution_key = client_tag || session_id, attribution_source = client_tag|session_id. That way downstream billing can de-dupe by attribution_key.
anya: Are we ok with adding attribution_source to all provisional events? storage cost/time series increase?
luke: it's a small string tag; we already carry route/model strings. Cost negligible. The dedupe logic would run at reconciliation: if multiple provisional entries share attribution_key and overlapping token ranges within a short window, collapse them.
jess: For rollout: propose feature flag gating. Start by emitting telemetry and ledger fields but not changing dedupe. After one week of monitoring (and a dashboard), enable dedupe.
miguel: Agreed. Action items: luke will add session_tag forwarding in a small RPC patch + telemetry for missing tags; jess will produce console mock and update the metrics dashboard; anya will own an alert for handoff.missing_session_tag > threshold; miguel will open ledger PR to add attribution_key/source and a reconciliation heuristic.
ops-bot: Created issue #6121: "session_tag propagation + provisional attribution" and linked to PR template.
jess: I'll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow to review UX + dashboards.
luke: PR coming in the morning. I'll try to keep changes minimal (explicit whitelist of metadata on handoff RPC).
anya: one more thought — what about toolcalls? If a toolcall truncates or retries, same problem could happen. Suggest we also propagate session_tag through toolcall broker and mark toolcall.truncated events with attribution_key.
miguel: good catch. include toolcall flow in the ledger tests.
jess: ok, thanks all. small wins but should reduce noise and customer confusion. :thumbsup:
